observations: Photo 0 shows a black PS4 Slim console (slim flat body, single power-light strip, PS4 Slim-style ridges) sitting on a wooden surface.
Two sealed-looking Sony DualShock 4 controller boxes are stacked behind the console, each printed 'PS4 DUALSHOCK 4 Wireless Controller'.
A small black object (possibly a USB/HDD dongle) sits to the right of the console.
Image carries a jiji watermark and a seller name overlay 'DERA NWOYE'.
No power cable, HDMI cable, serial number, capacity sticker, or screen showing the console powered on are visible.
No visible UK plug, import sticker, or region marking to support the 'Direct UK' claim.

identity.kind: PS4 Slim game console with two DualShock 4 controllers

claims.evidence: No UK plug, import label, or region sticker visible in photo 0.
No screen-on shot or menu screenshot showing jailbreak/games list; console appears off.

claims.claim: Comes with two brand new pads
claims.evidence: Boxes look sealed in photo 0, but boxes alone do not prove the controllers inside are new, unused, or even present and working.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have hardware faults (overheating, disc drive, HDMI port).
risks.proof: Video of console powering on to the PS4 home screen.

risks.risk: Jailbreak/hack may be unstable, outdated, or non-functional, risking bricking or no online updates.
risks.proof: Screenshot of system software version and jailbreak menu (e.g., Mira/Goldhen) running on the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced as basic stock console, not as a premium modded unit

risks.risk: Controllers inside the boxes may be used, mismatched, or missing despite sealed-looking packaging.
risks.proof: Photo of both controllers removed from boxes showing serial stickers and condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/used controllers, not as 'brand new'

risks.risk: Storage capacity and true origin (UK vs other region) unverified.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear/base sticker showing model number, capacity, and region code.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base/unspecified capacity, no origin premium

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the hacked menu/games list.
Close-up of the base/rear sticker showing model number, storage capacity, and region.
Photos of both controllers out of the box with serials visible.
Any UK import documentation, box, or plug type to support 'Direct UK' claim.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PS4 Slim bundle with two boxed controllers, but all seller claims (UK origin, hack functionality, controller newness) are unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at the worst-case baseline for a hacked PS4 with controller comparable to similar rivers listings.
